title: Tom Cruise trades stunts for satire as toxic tycoon 'Digger'
summary: Tom Cruise has taken on one of his riskiest roles in decades, tackling the politics of climate change and corporate greed in new film "Digger" which was savaged by some critics on Tuesday.
